notes.title: 📺 Live Now: Forged in Germany – Iconic Dev Stream
notes.content: [h3]Join the Developer for a Preview of Iconic in its Current State[/h3][p]Join us as we dive into [i]Iconic[/i], our new take on the horde survival roguelite genre featured in the [i]Games Forged in Germany[/i] event! 🛡️⚔️[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in the development of Iconic, be sure to visit our Discord Server:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/DmRgUnkYUZ"]https://discord.gg/DmRgUnkYUZ[/url][/p]
